comingSoon.tagline: The handball fantasy game based on real Daikin StarLigue players. Build your team and score points on their real performances, matchday after matchday.
comingSoon.footerDisclaimer: Personal project, not officially affiliated with the LNH or the Daikin StarLigue — launching before the season kicks off.

squad.title: Build your squad
squad.description: 14 players across the 16 Starligue clubs, a tight budget, one position at a time — goalkeeper, wings, backs, centre back, pivot.

lineup.title: Set your lineup every matchday
lineup.description: 7 starters on the pitch, 7 substitutes on the bench. A deadline before every kickoff, just like the real thing.

score.title: Score on the real thing
score.description: Goals, saves, assists: every match stat counts towards your matchday score.

challenge.title: Challenge your friends
challenge.description: Create your private league, follow the live standings, trade players between matchdays.
